clips.text: Making a pixel reel starts with one sentence. You tell Claude what you'd like explained.
It can be a link to an article. A letter you've been sent. Or just a question, like, how does a mortgage work.
First, add Pixel Reel to Claude. It only takes a minute, and it works with every Claude plan.
Then ask Claude for a pixel reel of anything you like. Claude writes it, I read it out, and you press Play.
